bio: Passionate automobile engineer specializing in robotics, machine learning, and Formula Student competitions. Experienced in CAD/CAE, signal processing, and developing innovative engineering solutions.
shortBio: Building the future of automotive engineering through robotics, ML, and Formula Student innovation.

experience.description: Leading a team of engineers in designing and building a Formula Student race car. Managing project timelines, coordinating between mechanical, electrical, and software teams, and ensuring competition readiness.
Participated in multiple robotics competitions including IIT Techfest, designing and building autonomous robots for various challenges including Robosoccer and gripper mechanisms.
Researching and developing machine learning models for engine fault detection using audio signal processing techniques including MFCC, FFT, and DWT.
